visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a white t-shirt, white cap, and black shorts walks through a retail store aisle, licking a vanilla ice cream cone with an exaggerated expression. The environment is a brightly lit IKEA warehouse with white vertical pillars and blue signage. (2) The man approaches a young boy in a mint green shirt leaning against a white door. The man holds the ice cream near the boy's face. (3) The man reveals a second ice cream cone from behind his back, making the boy look up with anticipation. (4) Instead of giving the ice cream to the boy, the man begins eating both cones simultaneously, dancing and licking them greedily. The boy reaches out his hand but is left empty-handed. (5) Multiple close-up shots show the man looking directly at the camera while consuming both ice creams with high energy. (6) The camera cuts to the boy who now looks extremely angry, clenching his fists and staring intensely at the camera. (7) A final scene cut shows a different, younger baby in a star-patterned shirt sitting on a bed and laughing hysterically at the camera.

The atmosphere is melancholic and peaceful. (2) At 00:28, there is a sharp acoustic discontinuity where the music cuts out completely. (3) A loud, high-pitched, and continuous baby laughter SFX erupts, dominating the frequency spectrum. The sound is high-arousal and sharp, contrasting sharply with the previous musical section.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic skit designed for short-form social media consumption. It uses a sentimental music track to set up a 'sweet' expectation between an adult and a child, only to subvert it for comedic effect by having the adult selfishly eat the ice cream. The final cut to a laughing baby serves as a meta-reaction or 'punchline' to the absurdity of the prank.
